releasePlan.notes: Flag created as string multivariate (control/v1). Control path: original welcome overlay shown directly, anonymous LD context maintained. v1 path: callsign login overlay shown first; player name stored in localStorage, displayed in HUD, and used to re-identify the LD context via ldClient.identify(). Flag evaluated after await initLaunchDarkly() so targeting is accurate at evaluation time. restartGame() defensively hides loginOverlay unconditionally (no-op in control path). No prerequisites.
